PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby declare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land Nos. 2, 7, 13, 61, 65 and 69 of Block 07, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 620401, situated in the Village of wathupitiya within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 173 A - Wathupitiya in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Nivithigala, in the Dis-trict of Ratnapura, in the Province of Sabaragamuwa, referred to in Notice No. 62/0490 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2009/41 of 10th March, 2017 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 16th July, 2018
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
No. 2082/48 – THURSDAY, AUGUST 02, 2018
